title: 第490章 暴怒的欧阳庄主
slug: 天赋太差全凭系统黑化
content_zh:
欧阳庄主意识到欧阳冷傲不是林雲的对手，立即阻止林雲发动二次进攻，让林雲立即离开欧阳山庄。
欧阳庄主顾忌欧阳家的颜面，本不屑于以庄主的身份来对付林雲。可林雲竟然提出如此过分的要求，当众要带走上官玉儿。
林雲倒也不惧，天地间的虚影凤凰并并没有阻挡欧阳山庄的圣境道则攻击，而是杀向欧阳冷傲。
倒在结界光幕之中的欧阳冷傲已经被林雲打得斗志全失，面对虚影凤凰攻击甚至没有释放出防御神威。
“小子！住手！”欧阳庄主大怒，身下的座椅当场炸裂，欧阳庄主化为一道闪电圣光冲向林雲。
即使欧阳庄主出手阻止，可依然没能阻止林雲的凤凰刀锋杀向欧阳冷傲。
狂暴的虚影凤凰重重的轰在欧阳冷傲身上，欧阳冷傲身上的鲜血当即炸开，漫天都被鲜血染红了！
“冷傲！冷傲！”欧阳庄主的身形出现在欧阳冷傲身边，双手当即释放出圣境神威打入欧阳冷傲体内。
可欧阳冷傲体内生机已经急速流失，即使欧阳庄主不断将神威气息输入欧阳冷傲的神体之内，可也无法挽留欧阳冷傲的生机。
欧阳家族未来的继承人，欧阳冷傲的气息越来越微弱，终于倒在欧阳庄主的怀中。
欧阳家未来的继承人当场陨落，这下林雲的行为直接捅破天了。有聪明的武者已经开始撤离欧阳山庄，足足远离欧阳山庄百里之外。
content_en:
The owner of Ouyang Villa realized that Ouyang Lengao was no match for Lin Yun, and immediately stopped Lin Yun from launching a second attack and asked Lin Yun to leave Ouyang Villa immediately.
The owner of the village, Ouyang, was concerned about the face of the Ouyang family and did not bother to deal with Lin Yun as the owner of the village. But Lin Yun actually made such an exorbitant request and wanted to take Shangguan Yu'er away in public.
Lin Yun was not afraid. The phantom phoenix in the sky and the earth did not block Ouyang Villa's holy realm attack, but killed Ouyang Lengao.
Ouyang Lengao, who fell in the barrier of light, had been beaten by Lin Yun and lost all his fighting spirit. He did not even release his defensive power when faced with the attack of the phantom phoenix.
"Boy! Stop!" Master Ouyang was furious, and the seat beneath him exploded on the spot. Master Ouyang turned into a bolt of lightning and rushed towards Lin Yun.
Even though Master Ouyang tried to stop him, he still couldn't stop Lin Yun's Phoenix Blade from attacking Ouyang Leng'ao.
The violent phantom phoenix hit Ouyang Leng'ao heavily. The blood on Ouyang Leng'ao's body exploded immediately, and the sky was dyed red with blood!
"Leng Ao! Leng Ao!" The figure of Ouyang Manor Master appeared next to Ouyang Leng Ao, and his hands immediately released the divine power of the Holy Realm and penetrated into Ouyang Leng Ao's body.
But the vitality in Ouyang Leng'ao's body has been rapidly drained. Even if Ouyang Manor Master continuously inputs the divine aura into Ouyang Leng'ao's divine body, he cannot save Ouyang Leng'ao's vitality.
The future heir of the Ouyang family, Ouyang Lengao's aura became weaker and weaker, and finally fell into the arms of Master Ouyang.
The future heir of the Ouyang family died on the spot, and Lin Yun's behavior was directly shocking. Some smart warriors have begun to evacuate Ouyang Villa, a hundred miles away from Ouyang Villa.
